summary: Reproduced that Qwen3.5 pipeline-parallel weight filtering treated model.visual.layers.N as decoder layer N and dropped visual encoder weights outside the local decoder range. Restricted the four Qwen3.5 PP filters to normalized model.layers.N names and added a regression using the actual conditional-generation load_weights implementation plus independent namespace and PP-boundary cases.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: decoder layers at the local range boundaries were filtered as expected, but model.visual.layers.3.weight was incorrectly absent from the loaded set. Raw output: reports/j-171f439b3fc8/raw/failing-before.log

Passing-after regression and boundary coverage: 7 tests passed, including actual Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.load_weights behavior for decoder indices below, inside, and at the exclusive end of the PP range, an out-of-range visual encoder layer, and independent visual/audio/bare namespace cases. Raw output: reports/j-171f439b3fc8/raw/passing-after-format.log
All applicable repository formatting, lint, syntax, registry, and hygiene hooks passed. Raw output: reports/j-171f439b3fc8/raw/pre-commit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The reproduced defect is deterministic weight-name filtering performed before tensor placement. No GPU execution was used or claimed.

remaining_limitations: No Qwen3.5 model weights were available, so a full checkpoint load was not performed.
No multi-process or multi-node pipeline-parallel serving workload was run; the regression exercises the actual load_weights implementation with a deterministic minimal module fixture.
Semantic model accuracy and serving behavior were not evaluated because the bug occurs before encoder tensors are copied and the fixture does not represent a complete model.
